query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Find software engineering job listings matching role, location, remote-work, and salary criteria, compile the results, and send or provide them to someone.

requirement_groups.purpose: Search the web for jobs matching specific criteria

query_ground_truth.rationale: Finding software engineering job listings requires a web search or answer engine tool to scour job boards and company pages.

request.query: software engineering job listings matching role location remote salary

results.use_case: software engineering job listings matching role location remote salary
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Step]: Discover recent senior-level role postings using COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB (include remote/hybrid constraints and target official employer or applicant-tracking pages), and capture candidate links from results.citations.

[Required] [Next Step]: Refine with a few tighter COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB queries (role variants, seniority, tech keywords, location modifiers), then deduplicate and prioritize direct posting pages over listing hubs.

[Optional (if a job-SERP feed is preferred)] [Next Step]: Expand discovery using SERPHOUSE_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH (optionally refine geo via SERPHOUSE_LOCATION_SEARCH and language via SERPHOUSE_LANGUAGE_LIST) and merge/dedupe into the URL set.

[Optional (if key sites are dynamic or require multi-step navigation)] [Fallback]: Use FIRECRAWL_START_AGENT and poll FIRECRAWL_GET_AGENT_STATUS to extract final posting URLs when simple link collection is insufficient.
known_pitfalls: [COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB] results.answer may be narrative and not reliably attributable; prefer results.citations for auditable URLs/snippets.
[COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB] Overlapping queries can return the same posting multiple times; deduplicate by canonical URL before review.
[FIRECRAWL_START_AGENT] Crawls are asynchronous; you must poll completion via FIRECRAWL_GET_AGENT_STATUS before trusting extracted links.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB.description: Perform a web search using the Exa API. Returns a nested structure: narrative summary under results.answer, sources under results.citations (and optionally results.organic_results). Prioritize results.citations as primary evidence over results.answer, which can be vague. Only indexes publicly available content — no paywalled, login-gated, or private content. No date filters enforced; include recency terms in query and verify dates in snippets manually. Throttle to ~1–2 requests/second; bursty queries trigger HTTP 429. Large responses may be stored remotely — use structure_info to locate results.answer and results.citations.

query.description: The search query for the Composio Exa API. Must be non-empty; using any other parameter name (e.g., 'q') causes an invalid-request error. Include qualifiers (year, region, platform, intent) for better results — broad queries return generic content; excessive site: or quoted-term filters can return zero results. Add disambiguating terms (city, role, domain) when searching for people or organizations with common names.

SERPHOUSE_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH.description: Tool to perform real-time Google Jobs search to retrieve job listings. Use when you need to search for job postings on Google with specific query terms, location, and filters.

q.description: Search phrase to query for job listings.

loc.description: Location name as string (e.g., 'New York,New York,United States'). Mutually exclusive with loc_id - provide either loc or loc_id, not both.

lang.description: Language code for search results (e.g., 'en' for English, 'fr' for French).

loc_id.description: Location ID as integer. Mutually exclusive with loc - provide either loc or loc_id, not both.

date_range.description: Filter by posting date. Accepts 'h' (past hour), 'd' (24 hours), 'w' (week), 'm' (month), 'y' (year), or custom date range format.

COMPOSIO_SEARCH_FETCH_URL_CONTENT.description: Fetch and extract clean, readable page text (markdown) from public web pages (HTML content) using the Exa API. Use when you need to retrieve actual content from search results or documentation links to extract setup steps, requirements, or citations. Only works with web page URLs - does not support direct links to images, PDFs, or other binary files.

text.description: Include extracted markdown text content from the page. Defaults to true.

urls.description: List of public URLs to web pages (HTML content) to fetch content from. URLs must be valid and publicly accessible. Do not use direct links to images (.jpg, .png, .gif), PDFs, or other binary files - use web page URLs only. Also accepts a single URL string.

extras.description: Additional content options like imageLinks or links counts (e.g., {'imageLinks': 3, 'links': 5}).

summary.description: Include AI-generated summary of the page content. Can be boolean or object with query/schema options.

max_characters.description: Maximum number of characters to extract from each page. Maps to text.maxCharacters in Exa API.
